svg.text: The installer reads tanium-init.dat beside it, the service registers on TCP 17472 with the server's trust key, joins the subnet peer chain, and the console can ask it questions.

svg.text: Only the chain leader and backward leader reach the server; a host firewall that blocks peering makes every client talk to the server directly. Controls: CM-8, SI-7 (hashes and trust key), AU-12 (JSON evidence).

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Segoe UI Web', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Generalised design: no client names, tenant IDs, addresses or data. Icons are simplified originals, not Microsoft artwork.

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Segoe UI Web', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
